package.name: pendulum_safety
package.description: Centralised safety enforcement for the LDR pendulum testbed. Provides a shared, realtime-safe limiter library (position / velocity / effort clamps, slew-rate and acceleration limiting, thermal Kp derating) linked by the PD, PVT and policy control paths, plus a standalone supervisor node that performs all breach detection (position, velocity, effort, temperature, bus voltage, stale joint state) and drives a configurable, manually-reset emergency stop with per-trigger FREE / HOLD action.
